integrity: The stated universal conclusions are supported by explicit probabilistic proofs; independent audit and independent publication-priority assessment have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Not extended to voter-dependent or correlated approvals.
No finite-sample exact worst-case failure probability or sharp prefactor is claimed.
No theorem on EJR/PJR probability maximization or selection using observed ballots.
Related asymptotic JR, CORE, and EJR+ guarantees are prior art.
Priority over uninspected broader probability identities is not independently assessed.
scientific_scope: Independent Bernoulli approvals with candidate-specific probabilities constant across voters, any finite n,m,k. Exact JR probability and optimizer; sharp large-deviation rate for fixed m>k as n tends to infinity.
title: Exact finite-electorate justified-representation probabilities and their sharp universal failure exponent
